# How to translate this chunk

This file holds `items`, a list of `{"k", "ctx", "t"}`. `t` is English text
that a reader of an Indian app or website sees. `ctx` is the field it came
from, such as label, hint, button, documents, brief or title. Use it to judge
tone and length: a label stays short, a hint can be a sentence.

Write `{"items": [{"k": ..., "t": ...}, ...]}` to the path in `write_to`.
Keep every `k` unchanged and in the same order. Put the translation in `t`.
Leave out `ctx`. Do not add, merge, split or drop items.

## Keep these exactly as they are

- Placeholders and markup: `{0}`, `{name}`, `%s`, `%d`, `%1$s`, HTML tags, `\n`.
- Website addresses, e-mail addresses and links.
- Every number: phone and toll-free numbers, Aadhaar, account, IFSC, PAN, PIN
  codes, amounts, dates, percentages. Write digits as 0-9, the Western digits,
  in every language, including Urdu. People type these into forms that take
  Western digits.
- Acronyms people know in Latin letters: OTP, PAN, IFSC, UPI, KYC, e-KYC, DBT,
  BPL, APL, NFSA, PM-KISAN, SMS, PDF, ID.

## Names

- Product, app, portal and scheme names: transliterate them into the script so
  they read naturally. Keep any acronym inside them in Latin, so "APPSC
  portal" becomes APPSC followed by the word for portal.
- A button or menu label quoted from a website, such as 'Apply Online' or
  'Register', stays in English inside quotes. The reader has to find that exact
  English word on the screen.
- People and places in examples are transliterated, never replaced with other
  names.
- Government office titles are transliterated so the reader can say them at
  the counter: Tahsildar, Patwari, Talathi, Mamlatdar, BDO, Collector, Gram
  Panchayat. The language notes below give the usual local forms.

## Tone

Write for an ordinary person who may be elderly and may have had little
schooling. Use everyday spoken language, not heavy official vocabulary. Where
people really say the English word, write it in the script: online, form,
portal, login, mobile, bank, certificate, download, upload, app. Keep
instructions short and direct, in the form "do this".

"Gender" means sex (male or female). It is never the word for caste.

## Before you write

Check that you have the same number of items as the input and that every
number and placeholder came through. Write the whole file in ONE Write call,
as valid UTF-8 JSON with no `\u` escapes and nothing else in the file.

## Hindi (hi)

Script: Devanagari. Used in UP, MP, Bihar, Rajasthan, Haryana, HP, Uttarakhand,
Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh and Delhi, and understood across the north.
Tone: everyday spoken Hindi (Hindustani). Avoid Sanskritised official words.
Words: ऑनलाइन, फॉर्म, पोर्टल, लॉगिन, आधार, बैंक, मोबाइल, OTP, हेल्पलाइन,
सर्टिफिकेट, डाउनलोड, अपलोड.
UI: आवेदन करें (Apply), जमा करें (Submit), आगे (Next), पीछे (Back), खोजें (Search),
शेयर करें (Share), सेटिंग (Settings), भाषा (Language), मदद (Help).
Offices: तहसीलदार, पटवारी, ग्राम पंचायत, कलेक्टर, ब्लॉक विकास कार्यालय (BDO).
Gender: लिंग (never जाति). Money: रु. 6,000; रु. 8 लाख. September: सितंबर.

## Gujarati (gu)

Script: Gujarati. Used in Gujarat, and spoken in Dadra & Nagar Haveli and
Daman & Diu.
Tone: everyday spoken Gujarati.
Words: ઓનલાઇન, ફોર્મ, પોર્ટલ, લૉગિન, આધાર, બેંક, મોબાઇલ, OTP, હેલ્પલાઇન, સર્ટિફિકેટ / દાખલો,
ડાઉનલોડ, અપલોડ.
UI: અરજી કરો, સબમિટ કરો, આગળ, પાછળ, શોધો, શેર કરો, સેટિંગ્સ, ભાષા, મદદ.
Offices: મામલતદાર, તલાટી, ગ્રામ પંચાયત, કલેક્ટર, તાલુકા પંચાયત.
Gender: જાતિ is caste; use લિંગ. Money: રૂ. 6,000; રૂ. 8 લાખ. September: સપ્ટેમ્બર.

## Marathi (mr)

Script: Devanagari. Used in Maharashtra, and widely in Goa.
Tone: everyday Marathi as spoken in Maharashtra.
Words: ऑनलाइन, फॉर्म, पोर्टल, लॉगिन, आधार, बँक, मोबाइल, OTP, हेल्पलाइन, दाखला / सर्टिफिकेट,
डाउनलोड, अपलोड.
UI: अर्ज करा, सबमिट करा, पुढे, मागे, शोधा, शेअर करा, सेटिंग्ज, भाषा, मदत.
Offices: तहसीलदार, तलाठी, ग्रामपंचायत, जिल्हाधिकारी (कलेक्टर), आपले सरकार सेवा केंद्र.
Gender: लिंग. Money: रु. 6,000; रु. 8 लाख. September: सप्टेंबर.

## Bengali (bn)

Script: Bengali. Used in West Bengal and Tripura, and in Assam's Barak Valley
and the Andamans.
Tone: everyday spoken Bengali (চলিত ভাষা), not সাধু ভাষা.
Words: অনলাইন, ফর্ম, পোর্টাল, লগইন, আধার, ব্যাংক, মোবাইল, OTP, হেল্পলাইন, সার্টিফিকেট,
ডাউনলোড, আপলোড.
UI: আবেদন করুন, জমা দিন, পরবর্তী, পিছনে, খুঁজুন, শেয়ার করুন, সেটিংস, ভাষা, সাহায্য.
Offices: বিডিও অফিস, গ্রাম পঞ্চায়েত, তহসিলদার, জেলাশাসক (কালেক্টর), দুয়ারে সরকার.
Gender: লিঙ্গ. Money: 6,000 টাকা; 8 লাখ টাকা. September: সেপ্টেম্বর.

## Assamese (as)

Script: Bengali script with the Assamese letters ৰ and ৱ. Used in Assam.
This is Assamese, not Bengali. Use Assamese words and spellings: আঁচনি
(scheme), বেংক (bank), কৰক (do), নহয় (is not).
Words: অনলাইন, প্ৰপত্ৰ / ফৰ্ম, পৰ্টেল, লগইন, আধাৰ, বেংক, মবাইল, OTP, হেল্পলাইন, প্ৰমাণপত্ৰ,
ডাউনল'ড, আপল'ড.
UI: আবেদন কৰক, দাখিল কৰক, পৰৱৰ্তী, উভতি যাওক, বিচাৰক, শ্বেয়াৰ কৰক, ছেটিংছ, ভাষা, সহায়.
Offices: চক্ৰ বিষয়াৰ কাৰ্যালয় (Circle Office), গাঁও পঞ্চায়ত, উন্নয়ন খণ্ড কাৰ্যালয় (BDO),
জিলা উপায়ুক্ত.
Gender: লিংগ. Money: 6,000 টকা; 8 লাখ টকা. September: ছেপ্তেম্বৰ.

Registration starts with your Aadhaar and an OTP. You register only once; the same login is used for every AIMS service.

Insure all the coconut trees in that plot; at least 10 are needed.

Open Services, then State Crop Insurance, press Apply next to the crop, enter the number of trees or the area and the period, tick the declaration and submit. The application goes to your Krishi Bhavan.

The compensation is paid straight into your bank account when funds are released.
If the crop was not insured, apply on AIMS in the same way for natural-calamity relief at the government's lower rates.

Ladakh Universal Health Care Scheme (Golden Card)

Ladakh's own free health insurance, started in December 2020 alongside Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY so that families left out of the PM-JAY list are covered too. Every ration card household gets a Golden Card worth Rs.5 lakh a year for hospital treatment, tests and medicines, cashless at empanelled hospitals. The card is made at the Ayushman desk of a government hospital, at an enrolment camp or at a CSC, using the ration card and Aadhaar.
Rs.5 lakh a year per household, cashless and free
Every family in UT Ladakh that holds a ration card
Families already in the PM-JAY list get the PM-JAY card; all others are covered by the UT's own scheme
No income limit and no premium
Newborn babies can be given a Golden Card at birth in the hospital
If your family is missing from the list or a name is wrong, apply first at the Tehsildar's office
Birth certificate for a newborn or a child without Aadhaar
For inclusion or name correction: a written application at the Tehsildar's office with copies of the ration card and Aadhaar

The Ayushman (PM-JAY) desk at SNM Hospital Leh, District Hospital Kargil or your nearest Community Health Centre, or a Common Service Centre or Golden Card camp in your block. Take the ration card, every member's Aadhaar card and the mobile phone linked to Aadhaar; each member to be enrolled should come along for the fingerprint, OTP or photo. If your family is not found or a name is wrong, first give an application with the same documents at your Tehsildar's office.
The operator finds your family with this number. Bring the card itself, not just a photo of it.
The person named first on the ration card.

How this member is related to the head of the family on the ration card.
Face straight, no cap or dark glasses.
Take the ration card, every member's Aadhaar and the Aadhaar-linked mobile to the Ayushman desk at SNM Hospital Leh, DH Kargil, a CHC, a CSC or a Golden Card camp.
The operator searches your family by ration card or Aadhaar and verifies each member by Aadhaar OTP, fingerprint or face.

If your family was not found, apply at the Tehsildar's office for inclusion, then go back to the desk to enrol.
At an empanelled hospital, show the card at the Ayushman desk and pay nothing for a covered treatment.
14555 or 1800-111-565 — Ayushman Bharat helpline / 01982-257561 — Health & Medical Education Department, UT Ladakh
UT of Lakshadweep State Pension Scheme (Old Age Pension)
Social Welfare & Tribal Affairs Department, Lakshadweep (through the District Panchayat and Village (Dweep) Panchayats)

Lakshadweep pays Rs.1,500 a month to permanent residents above 60 who have no income of their own. The same state pension also covers widows, abandoned people and persons with disabilities. You apply at your island's Village (Dweep) Panchayat office. The application is checked there and again at the District Panchayat, Kavaratti, and the money is paid every month into your Aadhaar-linked bank account. About 3,500 islanders get it.
Permanent resident of the Union territory of Lakshadweep
Above 60 years of age (the same scheme also covers widows, abandoned persons and persons with disabilities)
No source of income; monthly income not above Rs.1,500
Not getting any other similar government pension
People with no financial support from their family are given priority
Age proof (birth certificate or other record showing date of birth)
Residence certificate showing you are a permanent resident
Bank passbook of an Aadhaar-linked account in your own name
Social Welfare & Tribal Affairs Department, Lakshadweep

The office of the Executive Officer of the Village (Dweep) Panchayat on your island. The form is given there free. Hand it back with photocopies of your documents and show the originals. After the VDP Evaluation Committee checks it, the VDP sends it to the Chief Executive Officer, District Panchayat (HQ), Kavaratti.
As on your Aadhaar card. The form is collected at your VDP office; these are the details it asks for.

Mukhyamantri Kanya Vivah / Nikah Yojana (Samuhik Vivah)
Department of Social Justice and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Madhya Pradesh

The state gives Rs 55,000 for each bride who marries at a mass wedding held by a Janpad Panchayat or urban body on a date the district fixes. The bride gets Rs 49,000 by an account payee cheque in her name, and Rs 6,000 goes to the body that holds the event. The Nikah scheme gives the same help at mass nikah events. There is no income limit, but a wedding held on its own does not qualify.
Rs 55,000 per bride: Rs 49,000 cheque to the bride + Rs 6,000 to the organiser
The bride or her parents are original residents of Madhya Pradesh (the groom may be from another state)
The bride has completed 18 years and the groom 21 years
The bride is unmarried, a widow (Kalyani) or a legally divorced woman, and has not already married in another ceremony
No income limit, but the marriage must take place at a mass wedding or nikah held by a Janpad Panchayat or municipal body on a notified date
Registered construction workers also get this help through the same mass weddings; there is no separate grant for a wedding held on its own

Aadhaar card copies of the bride and the groom

Two passport-size photos each of the bride and the groom

For a widow, the former husband's death certificate; for a divorced woman, the court's divorce order

Mukhyamantri Kisan Kalyan Yojana (CM Kisan Kalyan)
Department of Farmer Welfare and Agriculture Development, with the Revenue Department, Madhya Pradesh

Madhya Pradesh adds Rs 6,000 a year to the Rs 6,000 farmers get from PM-Kisan, so a farmer family gets Rs 12,000 a year in all. The state pays it in three instalments of Rs 2,000 straight into the bank account. There is no separate form. Every MP farmer approved under PM-Kisan is added automatically once the Patwari has verified the land. This SAARA page shows whether you are active and when each instalment was paid.
Rs 6,000 a year (3 instalments of Rs 2,000) on top of PM-Kisan
Farmer families in Madhya Pradesh who are approved beneficiaries of PM-Kisan
Farm land recorded in the farmer's own name in MP land records (khasra or B-1)
PM-Kisan e-KYC done, and a bank account that is Aadhaar-seeded and DBT-enabled

Not eligible: income tax payers, serving or retired government employees (except Group D), pensioners getting Rs 10,000 or more a month, practising doctors, engineers, lawyers and CAs, and present or former MPs, MLAs and ministers
Each instalment is checked by the Patwari and approved by the Tehsildar before payment
Aadhaar card, with the mobile number linked for e-KYC OTP
Khasra or B-1 land record showing the land in your name
Bank passbook of an Aadhaar-seeded, DBT-enabled account
PM-Kisan registration number, if you are already registered

The farmer's own 12-digit Aadhaar, the same one given for PM-Kisan.
Copy the letters in the picture exactly. Reload the picture if you cannot read it.
Active means instalments will come. If it says Inactive, the next box tells you why.
Common reasons are e-KYC not done, land not seeded, or a name mismatch between Aadhaar, bank and land record. Take your papers to the Patwari or tehsil office to fix it.
Check that every piece of your land is listed. If a khasra is missing, tell the Patwari.

First check whether you already get PM-Kisan. If you do, you need not apply for this scheme; the state adds you automatically.

Complete PM-Kisan e-KYC with an Aadhaar OTP or face scan, and ask your bank to confirm the account is Aadhaar-seeded with DBT active.
The Patwari verifies your land on the SAARA system and the Tehsildar approves it.
Open saara.mp.gov.in, choose CM Kisan Kalyan Yojana beneficiary status (हितग्राही स्थिति), and search with your Aadhaar, bank account or PM-Kisan ID.
If it shows Inactive, go to the Patwari or tehsil office with Aadhaar, khasra and passbook and get the reason shown fixed.
Rs 2,000 comes into your account three times a year by DBT. The UTR number for each instalment appears on the same page.

Mukhyamantri Jan Kalyan (Sambal 2.0) Yojana (Sambal Card)
Madhya Pradesh Asangathit Shahri evam Gramin Karmkar Kalyan Mandal, Labour Department

Sambal is Madhya Pradesh's card for unorganised workers such as farm labourers, hawkers, domestic workers, tendu leaf collectors and, since 2024, gig and platform workers. A registered worker's family gets Rs 5,000 for the funeral, and Rs 2 lakh on a normal death or Rs 4 lakh on an accidental death. There is also help for disability, and Rs 16,000 maternity help for women workers. Sambal 2.0 (2022) reopened registration, including for workers rejected earlier. The card also makes the family eligible for the free Ayushman (Niramayam) card.
Rs 4 lakh accidental death, Rs 2 lakh normal death, Rs 16,000 maternity help, Rs 5,000 funeral
Resident of Madhya Pradesh aged 18 or above, with a Samagra ID and Aadhaar e-KYC
Works in the unorganised sector (36 listed kinds of work, such as farm labour, hawking, domestic work, tendu leaf collection, gig and platform work) and gets no PF, ESI or gratuity
Not an income tax payer and not in government service
Does not hold more than 1 hectare of farm land
Death and disability help is for registered workers aged 18 to 60. Maternity help is for a registered woman worker who delivers in a government hospital, for up to two births
Samagra member ID and family ID, with Aadhaar e-KYC done on Samagra
Aadhaar card, with the mobile number linked for OTP
Bank passbook of an Aadhaar-seeded account, with IFSC
Name, date of birth and relation of the nominee (a family member in the same Samagra)
For maternity help later: the pregnancy (MCP) card and the hospital discharge slip
The worker's own 9-digit Samagra member number, not the family number.
The 8-digit family number from the same Samagra slip. Your name, age and address are then filled in from Samagra.
Copy the letters in the box exactly, then press search.
Pick the work you actually do for a living. Gig workers, such as delivery riders, can choose platform work.
The family member who will receive the money if something happens to you. Pick someone from your own Samagra family.
As in the nominee's Samagra record.
How the nominee is related to you: wife, husband, son, daughter, mother or father.
From the first page of your passbook. The account must be in your own name and Aadhaar-seeded.
Type it twice exactly. A wrong digit sends the help money back.
Make sure your Samagra record is e-KYC'd with Aadhaar, on samagra.gov.in or at the gram panchayat or ward office.
Open sambal.mp.gov.in and choose Apply for registration (पंजीयन हेतु आवेदन करें). Enter your Samagra ID, family ID and the captcha. The panchayat or ward office can also do this for you.
Fill in the type of work, the nominee and the bank details, then submit. Note the application number and the name of the inquiry officer shown on screen.

The inquiry officer, usually the panchayat secretary or ward in-charge, checks your details. Then the Janpad Panchayat or municipal office approves the application. Track it under Application status (संबल आवेदन की स्थिति).
Once approved, download your Sambal card from the portal. If you are rejected, you can appeal online to the SDM (पंजीयन अपील).

For maternity help, register the pregnancy at the government hospital or with the ANM. Rs 4,000 comes after the checkups and Rs 12,000 after delivery in a government hospital, straight into your bank account.

On a death, the panchayat secretary or ward in-charge pays Rs 5,000 funeral help at once. The family applies at the Janpad or municipal office for the Rs 2 lakh or Rs 4 lakh, which is paid into the nominee's account.
State Health Agency (Deendayal Swasthya Suraksha Parishad), Public Health and Family Welfare Department, Madhya Pradesh

Madhya Pradesh runs Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY under the name Niramayam, and the state pays for many more families than the central list covers. Every family holding an NFSA food-grain slip (khadyann parchi) qualifies, as do Sambal and construction workers, ASHA and anganwadi workers, and everyone aged 70 or above. Each family gets free, cashless treatment up to Rs 5 lakh a year in empanelled government and private hospitals. You can make the card yourself on the Ayushman portal or app, or free at a Lok Seva Kendra, CSC or the hospital's Ayushman Mitra desk.
